en.title: Closest Subsequence Sum to Goal
en.description:
You may delete any elements, including all or none of them; find the minimum absolute difference between the sum of the remaining subsequence and goal. Negative numbers and the empty subsequence are allowed.

The input/output format was compiled by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n goal, and the second line contains n integers. 1≤n≤40, −10⁷≤nums[i]≤10⁷, −10⁹≤goal≤10⁹.
en.explanation: The answers are 0, 1, and 7 in order; the third example requires allowing the empty subsequence.
hints: Split the array in half, generate and sort all subset sums of each half, then use one pointer from the left and one from the right to find the sum closest to goal.
